hints.title: Match prefixes
hints.body: Let `dp[i][j]` be the number of ways to form the first `j` characters of `t` using the first `i` characters of `s`.

hints.title: Decide about the last source character
hints.body: You may always delete `s[i-1]`, which contributes `dp[i-1][j]`. If it matches `t[j-1]`, you may also use it as the last matched character, contributing `dp[i-1][j-1]`.

hints.title: One row is enough
hints.body: `dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + (s[i-1] == t[j-1] ? dp[i-1][j-1] : 0)`. Set the empty-target column to 1. Update the row downward or use a copy so each source character is considered once.
